mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 70% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 140,000) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%) signal robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where PAYEMS > 140,000 and UNRATE < 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%) activate aggressive Federal Reserve stimulus, increasing liquidity and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900 thousand (HOUST > 900) indicate strong consumer confidence and construction activity, correlating with rising corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (INDPRO > 105) reflects robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, typically preceding stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16,300) and housing starts (HOUST > 900) signal a strong economic cycle that fuels corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 70% or more of instances where both GDPC1 > 16,300 and HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%) prompt aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes to curb inflation, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in 70% or more of instances where UNRATE < 4.5.
